title: Diagonal Matrix Game Value
body_html:
Diagonal Matrix Game Value

Let $A$ be the diagonal $n\times n$ matrix with diagonal entries $a_i>0$. Then $$ \operatorname{val}(A)= \left(\sum_{i=1}^n a_i^{-1}\right)^{-1}. $$ Both players have the same optimal mixed strategy $p\in\Delta(\{1,\ldots,n\})$ given by $$ p_i= \frac{a_i^{-1}}{\sum_{k=1}^n a_k^{-1}}. $$

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 2.8, Exercise 6] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Compute value and optimal strategies for a positive diagonal matrix game.
